notes: Cash basis; all governmental (no business-type funds; school nutrition is a special revenue fund in the governmental statement). Top-level figures use the Total Governmental Funds column (p6, left half p5); beginning cash = beginning fund balance 99,199,627. Statement p5 General Fund column includes the Depreciation fund (committed capital assets 3,910,431), so the 2,750,000 General-to-Depreciation transfer is internal and is not in transfers_in/out; in detail it is shown as an other financing pair (-2,750,000 General p9, +2,750,000 Depreciation p10) and General transfer line is outside the printed total disbursements. Local receipts 69,049,331 split by the fund schedules' own lines (sum ties); statement 'Other' disbursements 2,347,406 split into nutrition 611,110 and activities 1,736,296 per p5. Sale of capital assets 99,070 is other_financing per statement p6 (building schedule p12 lists it as local Other revenue). County receipts 251,687 split by the statement's fund columns p5 (General 250,915 = code 2110 county fines p7; Nutrition 772). Building schedule 'Other' 99,070 is in detail as other financing (inside its printed total receipts, includes other financing). Special Building receipts p5 533,232 = 533,206 + 26. Activities fund has no detail schedule (not trimmed), so no detail lines for it. General Fund expenditures are program totals only (no object breakdown), so detail_category not itemized. Lines printed as dashes (zero actual) were skipped in expenditures (2732, 2770 stray, nutrition purchased services, debt other expenses). Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis p1 (no liabilities). Read pages 1-13 of 13
